Title: Científico de datos
Place: Las Rozas de Madrid, Community of Madrid, Spain

Desde E-Frontiers estamos buscando un perfil de Data Scientist para formar parte de uno de nuestros clientes: una empresa de datos y analítica que ayuda a tomar decisiones en sectores como el inmobiliario, marketing y finanzas. Experiencia en el manejo y tratamiento de grandes volúmenes de datos

Experiencia con R o Spark

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Fraud Detection
Description:
Senior Data Scientist (Fraud Detection) Madrid / WFH to €65,000




Are you a Data Scientist with Fraud Detection experience?




You could be progressing your career in as a Senior Data Scientist as part of a friendly and supportive international team at a growing and hugely successful European car insurance tech company as they expand their UK presence.




As a Senior Data Scientist within the Anti Fraud Team you'll design and improve fraud detection systems that prioritise high risk claims, optimising the trade-off between detection accuracy and operational efficiency. Developing deep expertise in fraud dynamics, you'll identify emerging fraud patterns, understand how they evolve across the insurance lifecycle and translate these insights into effective detection and prevention strategies.




Collaborating across teams and functions, you'll work closely with fraud analysts, engineers and product managers within a supportive, diverse environment where you'll have your voice heard.




Location / WFH:

The company is a big advocate of flexible working and prides itself on DEI; you can work from home most of the time, meeting up with colleagues in the Madrid office once a week.




About you:

You have experience in analytical fraud detection in the Insurance, Finance or Law Enforcement sectors
You have a strong knowledge of network analysis, anomaly detection or risk scoring and segmentation to real fraud problems
You have strong Python programming skills, especially in the data domain, and fluent use of Git
You have a good knowledge of Spark, SQL or other data-oriented programming language and are proficient with standard data wrangling and modelling libraries (e.g. Pandas, Keras, XGBoost, LightGBM)
You're collaborative and pragmatic with great communication skills




What's in it for you:

As a Senior Data Scientist (Fraud Detection) you will receive a competitive package:

Salary to €65,000 + bonus
Flexible / remote working including flexible working hours
Ability to work 30 days from any EU country
Diverse, inclusive team environment with a range of support networks (e.g. LGBTIQA+, Women's Networking group)




Apply now to find out more about this Senior Data Scientist (Fraud Detection) opportunity.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
¿Te motiva extraer valor de los datos, construir modelos predictivos y llevar soluciones analíticas a producción? ¡Queremos conocerte!

Buscamos una persona especializada en Data Science para desarrollar modelos avanzados, trabajar con grandes volúmenes de datos y desplegar soluciones en entornos cloud Azure, en proyectos reales de alto impacto.




¿Qué harás en tu día a día?




➡️ Analizar grandes volúmenes de datos para extraer insights accionables que apoyen la toma de decisiones.

➡️ Desarrollar, entrenar y validar modelos de machine learning y estadística avanzada.

➡️ Trabajar con Python y sus principales librerías (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, etc.) para el procesamiento y modelado de datos.

➡️ Implementar y desplegar modelos en entornos Azure (Azure Machine Learning, Azure Databricks, etc.).

➡️ Colaborar con equipos de Data Engineering para asegurar la correcta ingesta y disponibilidad de datos.

➡️ Diseñar experimentos y evaluar el rendimiento de modelos mediante métricas adecuadas.

➡️ Integrar modelos en aplicaciones o servicios orientados a negocio.

➡️ Documentar modelos, procesos analíticos y decisiones técnicas.




Encajarás perfectamente si…




✔️ Tienes experiencia de 3 años como Data Scientist o en roles similares.

✔️ Dominas Python aplicado a análisis de datos y machine learning.

✔️ Tienes experiencia con librerías de ciencia de datos (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.).

✔️ Has trabajado en entornos cloud, especialmente Azure.

✔️ Conoces técnicas de modelado estadístico y machine learning.

✔️ Tienes experiencia en visualización de datos y comunicación de resultados.

✔️ Tienes mentalidad analítica, orientación a resultados y buenas habilidades de comunicación.




Y sería un plus si además…




⭐ Has trabajado con Azure Machine Learning o Azure Databricks.

⭐ Tienes experiencia en despliegue de modelos (MLOps).

⭐ Conoces herramientas de versionado y seguimiento de experimentos.

⭐ Has trabajado con datos en tiempo real o modelos de predicción en producción.

⭐ Te interesa la optimización de modelos y su escalabilidad.




¿Qué ofrecemos?




✅ Proyectos tecnológicos retadores en entornos modernos de datos.

✅ Buen ambiente de trabajo y colaboración entre equipos técnicos.

✅ Plan de desarrollo profesional y formación continua.

✅ Horario flexible y posibilidad de teletrabajo / modalidad híbrida.

✅ Beneficios adicionales: seguro médico, formaciones, equipo técnico y más.

Title: Global Data Scientist Specialist
Description:
WHO WE ARE

Avolta is the world’s leading travel experience player. With a traveler-centric philosophy and a geographically diverse network, the travel retail and F&B company addresses the needs of up to 2.3 billion passengers each year, with 5,500 outlets in more than 75 countries across six continents. Guided by their Destination 2027 strategy and boosted by their recent combination with travel F&B giant Autogrill, the company is well positioned to realize their ambition to create a Travel Experience Revolution through their many locations at airports, motorways, cruise lines, seaports and railway stations amongst others.




PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Global Data Scientist Specialist will leverage advanced analytics and data science to unlock insights that drive strategic decisions and operational excellence across Avolta’s global IT landscape. This role is pivotal in transforming complex data into actionable intelligence, enabling innovation and supporting the company’s vision of revolutionizing the travel experience. This role will be based in Madrid with hybrid flexibility.




RESPONSIBILITIES

Identifies emerging analytic trends, data needs, and innovative solutions to address business challenges
Collaborates with the Analytics Business Analysts and key stakeholders to generate hypotheses and develop models that answer impactful business questions
Design and implement statistical models to extract meaningful insights from large datasets
Parses, cleanses, and manipulates structured and unstructured data for analysis
Conduct quality assurance testing to ensure accuracy and reliability of models
Works with data sourcing teams to develop, test, implement, and maintain analytic models, including attribute identification, exploratory data analysis, and data transformation
Partners with business teams to review data sources, resolve inconsistencies, and validate business logic for data discovery initiatives
Performs advanced text, quantitative, statistical, financial, and operational analyses.
Designs, builds, and scales end-to-end ML pipelines, enabling efficient data processing, model training, deployment, and monitoring in production environments




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Experience: Proven track record in data modeling using leading analytics tools and relational data structures
Technical Skills: Strong programming skills in Python, PySpark and SQL, with solid understanding of databases, data modeling, and data structures
Machine Learning Expertise: Strong foundation in machine learning techniques, including model selection, performance evaluation, and validation; experience with model explainability, interpretability, and auditability to ensure transparency and reliability in production environments
Big Data & Cloud: Hands-on experience with modern cloud-based data platforms, such as Databricks and familiarity with scalable data architecture
Collaboration: Ability to work cross-functionally with IT, business analysts, and data teams
Communication Skills: Strong communication and storytelling abilities, with a clear focus on translating complex analytical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders and business users
Languages: Fluent English (spoken and written)
Personal Competences: Team worker, able to lead and support others, and contribute to growth within a collaborative and agile team environment
Data Product Mindset: Experience delivering end-to-end data products, from data ingestion and modeling to deployment and business adoption
Visualization Skills: Experience with data visualization tools, especially Power BI, to effectively communicate insights and support decision-making

Title: Data Science
Description:
Desde HAYS estamos colaborando con una consultora española especializada en Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Inteligencia Artificial y transformación basada en datos. Acompaña a organizaciones de distintos sectores en la construcción de soluciones avanzadas basadas en datos, ayudándolas a convertir la información en ventajas competitivas y mejoras de negocio.




Actualmente buscamos incorporar un/a Data Scientist para participar en un proyecto de gran impacto dentro del sector retail, enfocado en modelos predictivos de previsión de demanda y optimización de procesos de planificación.

Trabajarás con grandes volúmenes de información y contribuirás a transformar los datos en decisiones estratégicas mediante técnicas avanzadas de Machine Learning, Deep Learning y modelización estadística.




Principales responsabilidades

Desarrollar modelos de forecasting para previsión de demanda utilizando técnicas estadísticas, Machine Learning y Deep Learning.
Construir y optimizar modelos de series temporales mediante algoritmos como ARIMA, SARIMA, XGBoost, LightGBM, LSTM y arquitecturas basadas en Transformers.
Trabajar con estructuras de datos jerárquicas y multinivel, gestionando diferentes niveles de granularidad.
Diseñar estrategias de feature engineering incorporando variables relacionadas con promociones, precios, estacionalidades, elasticidades, rupturas de stock y canibalización de productos.
Analizar grandes volúmenes de datos e identificar patrones que permitan mejorar la planificación y la toma de decisiones.
Implementar metodologías robustas de validación mediante backtesting y monitorización continua de resultados.
Definir y controlar métricas de rendimiento predictivo como MAPE, WMAPE y RMSE.
Desarrollar soluciones escalables utilizando Python y SQL.
Participar en la puesta en producción, monitorización y mejora continua de modelos analíticos.




Qué necesitarás

Data Science y Machine Learning aplicado a forecasting y predicción de demanda.
Desarrollo de modelos de series temporales.
Programación avanzada con Python y SQL.
Tratamiento y análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos.
Técnicas de validación y evaluación de modelos predictivos.
Conocimientos sólidos de estadística aplicada y analítica avanzada.
Nivel de inglés B2 o superior.




Qué ofrecemos

Incorporación a un proyecto estratégico con tecnologías punteras de analítica avanzada e inteligencia artificial.
Participación en iniciativas de alto impacto dentro de entornos data-driven.
Trabajo en un entorno altamente especializado y colaborativo.
Modelo de trabajo híbrido con gran flexibilidad y únicamente un día presencial a la semana.
Contrato indefinido.
Proyección profesional y crecimiento dentro de proyectos innovadores de Data & AI.




Si estás interesado/a en esta oportunidad y buscas un proyecto donde aplicar técnicas avanzadas de Data Science para resolver problemas reales de negocio, envíame tu CV actualizado y estaré encantada de contarte todos los detalles.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Kapsch is one of Austria's most successful global technology companies. With its

comprehensive ITS (Intelligent Transportation Systems) portfolio, Kapsch is actively addressing

the challenges of the present and the future with intelligent mobility solutions in a wide range

of application areas. As a family-owned company founded in 1892 and headquartered in

Vienna, Kapsch can look back on 130 years of experience with the future. To learn more about

our solutions and innovations, visit our website here.

We are looking for a Data Scientist with experience developing machine learning solutions and analytical models, from experimentation to validated production-ready models. You will work closely with the Product Owner, Data Engineers, MLOps Engineers, and Data Analysts to transform business challenges into scalable AI solutions and data products.

What You’ll Do


Design, develop, and validate machine learning models through iterative experimentation and PoC cycles.
Work directly with customers and stakeholders to understand business problems, define use cases, KPIs, and success criteria.
Develop forecasting, predictive, and analytical models, with strong focus on time series use cases.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Data Engineers, Data Analysts, and MLOps Engineers to deliver AI and ML solutions efficiently.
Perform feature engineering, model validation, and model performance analysis.
Build demo-ready PoCs and visualizations to communicate results and insights to stakeholders.
Track experiments, metrics, and model evolution using MLflow.
Work with analytical datasets and contribute to the definition of datasets and features for ML use cases.
Contribute to technical standards, best practices, and AI/ML solution design.


What We’re Looking For


4+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or similar role focused on analytical and ML solutions.
Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
Strong background in machine learning.
Experience managing ML experimentation cycles, model lifecycle, and production model maintenance, using tools such as MLflow or similar.
Proficiency in Python and experience working with SQL.
Experience working with analytical databases and large datasets.
Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow and notebook-based experimentation workflows.
Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.
Analytical mindset, fast learner, collaborative attitude, and customer-oriented approach.
Experience working in Agile environments.


Our offer


Permanent role.
Hybrid working model (3 days of remote work/week).
Flexible working hours.
30 business days of annual leave.
Flexible remuneration plan.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.

And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.

Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About The Role

The data science team, currently 11 members, focuses on pricing, classification of open banking data and credit decisioning. All data scientists actively contribute to building Render and adapting it to different use cases and products, by being directly embedded in the tech team. As we launch in Spain, we're hiring our first local data scientist to build out the credit risk model for the Spanish market, working closely with both our local Spanish team and our London-based Data Science team.

What You'll Be Doing


Work with our local Head of Credit Risk to build and develop the local credit risk model for the Spanish market, from initial development through to ongoing iteration and performance monitoring
Evaluate, select and integrate local data providers (bureau, Open Banking, alternative data) to power credit decisioning in Spain
Own reporting for the Spanish business: designing the dashboards, metrics and analytics infrastructure that give the team visibility into portfolio performance, risk and affordability
Work closely with the London-based data science team to adapt Render to the Spanish market, sharing methodology, code and lessons learned across geographies
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. product, finance, collections, underwriting, and the local credit risk and country leads) to translate data insights into pioneering solutions that drive product strategy and growth in Spain
Stay abreast of industry trends in AI, machine learning, and fintech to drive innovation


Who You Are


You have an advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field
You’ve got 3+ years of experience in a data science role. Credit risk or finance experience is a plus but not required, as you'll be supported by strong local expertise from our credit risk lead and country director
Strong SQL & Python skills and experience working directly with large datasets
You have a strong background in statistical modelling, machine learning algorithms, and data mining techniques
You're passionate about leveraging AI and data to improve financial inclusion and access to fair credit
You have excellent communication skills and can translate complex data insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and are comfortable working across English and Spanish
You're adaptable, innovative, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Experience with AWS is a plus

Ryanair Labs are currently recruiting for a Data Scientist to join Europe’s Largest Airline Group!

Ryanair Labs is the technology brand of Ryanair. Labs is a state of-the-art digital & IT innovation hub creating Europe’s Leading Travel Experience for our customers.

The role sits inside the BI team in Ryanair Labs. The BI team are made up of 95+ people split across the three Ryanair offices: Dublin, Madrid & Wroclaw. Within the BI team there is a range of different professions: Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Optimization Engineers, Data Modellers, BI Analysts, BI Reporters & BI Developers.

Lead the design, development, and implementation of advanced models and algorithms to optimise pricing strategies, segmentation or forecasting across the business.
Work autonomously to scope and deliver analysis of performance metrics, identifying the questions worth answering rather than waiting to be handed them.
Apply sophisticated statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms to analyse historical data, forecast demand, and identify pricing and revenue opportunities.
Conduct in-depth analysis of performance metrics, including revenue impact, price elasticity, and customer segmentation, to assess the effectiveness of strategies and drive continuous improvement.
Communicate findings clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex analysis into decisions stakeholders can act on.
Mentor and collaborate with team members and cross-functional partners, providing guidance on best practices, analytical methodologies, and data visualisation techniques.

Communication skills – most projects involve multiple people across various teams in different departments across the three offices. The role will involve regular presentations.

Strong Python and SQL experience is a necessity.
Experience with Databricks.
Basic knowledge of a cloud provider.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to develop predictive models and quantitative analytics that power risk-based vulnerability prioritization within a large-scale enterprise security program. You will structure and analyze massive security telemetry datasets, build ML algorithms to eliminate scanning noise and false positives, and establish unified data dashboards to drive adoption of data-driven security governance. The role requires 5+ years of data science experience with direct commercial application to vulnerability management, operating with full autonomy.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Develop predictive models and quantitative analytics to prioritize vulnerabilities based on contextual risk and business impact;
- Structure and analyze massive outputs of security data from across the enterprise ecosystem to support the ASPM framework;
- Create machine learning algorithms or statistical models to automatically identify and filter out scanning noise and false positives;
- Establish a unified data delivery structure and dashboards to drive the adoption of data-driven security governance.

MUST HAVES
- 5+ years of commercial data science experience, operating completely autonomously with no required supervision;
- Advanced proficiency in Python, R, and SQL;
- Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch;
- Experience with data visualization tools;
- Commercial experience applying data science to vulnerability management;
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Familiarity with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) data outputs (e.g., Wiz).

Description:
Department: Engineering

Description

Location: Madrid, Spain

Annual Remuneration: €95,000 - €115,000 and discretionary annual bonus

Pay Frequency: Monthly

Probationary Period: 180 days

Work Arrangement: Hybrid, 3-days per week

TL;DR Kharon is seeking a full-time Senior Data Scientist, Graph Risk Analytics based in Madrid.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:


Taking ownership of Kharon's risk propagation and entity analytics system — the engine that evaluates entities in our knowledge graph and surfaces meaningful risk signals to customers
Designing and implementing complex analytical logic that translate nuanced geopolitical and financial risk into structured, interpretable outputs
Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and graph-based ML systems that power risk scoring and entity analysis
Partnering closely with Research, Product, and Engineering teams to understand evolving risk frameworks and translate them into robust, maintainable systems
Iterating on the system's architecture to increase the complexity and precision it can handle — this is not a rip-and-replace, but a thoughtful evolution of a system already in production
Exploring how LLMs and other AI techniques can be integrated to handle increasingly complex risk logic


Qualifications


A proven interest or experience in global security, financial crimes, sanctions, export controls, or related domains
4+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, with demonstrated ownership of production systems
Strong foundation in statistics and the ability to apply quantitative methods to complex, real-world problems
Proficiency in Python, SQL, and working with graph databases or knowledge graph structures
Experience with graph analysis, graph ML, or network analysis — professional experience is a strong differentiator
Comfort working across research and data engineering contexts — this role spans all three
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and API development
Strong product instincts — able to go deep technically while staying aligned to customer and business outcomes
Bonus: Experience with LLMs or AI-assisted analytical systems


About Kharon

Kharon operates at the nexus of global security and is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible.

From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products. Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth.

As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details.

What You’ll Do


Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making;
Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers;
Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights.


What We’re Looking For


Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics;
Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems;
Fluency in English, both spoken and written.


Nice-to-Have


Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas;
Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python;
Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets.


€38,000 - €75,000 a year

Why you'll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from €38k up to €75k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist – Core Modelling

Madrid (Hybrid, 2 days onsite)

Permanent

€48,000 - €53,000 p/a




Our client is an IT consultancy operating on a global scale who are looking to hire a Data Scientist to join their Core Modelling team. Their clients operate in industries where they succeed based on the quality of predictions their operating models are based on. They are looking to recruit a Data Scientist who can get properly stuck into the core modelling work.




You’ll be working as part of a small team to build, train and evaluate machine learning models alongside senior team members who’ll guide you through the trickier problems. You will own your own workload and be trusted to manage your day-to-day but will have additional support should it be needed.




What You’ll actually be doing:

Cleaning, processing and exploring client data to find the patterns that matter
Building and evaluating Machine Learning models for prediction and classification tasks
Update and restrain existing foundation models as new data comes in
Working on the pipelines that get models from notebook to production
Presenting results clearly and for technical and non-technical stakeholders
Turn analysis into reports and visualisations using Tableau and Python




The Successful Data Scientist will have:

Previous experience in a Data Science role where you have gained a solid grounding in statistics, probability and core Machine Learning algorithms
Proficiency in Python including data manipulation libraries such as pandas or NumPy
Strong SQL skills for data extraction and manipulation
Experience with data visualisation libraries (malplotlib, seaborn, plotly) and creating reports in tools like Tableau
Strong teamworking skills but also the ability to work independently
Previous experience processing and exploring data in the iGaming sector would be an advantage but generally an industry involving predicting human behaviour in purchasing such as retail or banking could be suitable




If this sounds like the kind of challenge you’d actually enjoy, apply with your CV. If you have any questions please contact Adam on +44 7425 559 243.

Title: Data Scientist – Generative AI Specialist
HTML:
We are looking for Generative AI Specialists (junior, intermediate, and middle-senior profiles) to join BIP’s xTech Competence Centre, one of the largest Data Science communities in Europe.

You will work on advanced AI projects for leading enterprise clients across multiple industries, developing Generative AI solutions for real business use cases. You will be involved in initiatives leveraging pre-trained models (such as LLMs) as well as training and fine-tuning new models, especially in contexts with unstructured data (text, images, video, and audio).

In addition, you will actively contribute to the internal AI Community through research, technology scouting, solution design, and business development initiatives.

Mandatory Requirements
  • Master’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Mathematical Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, or related STEM disciplines;
  • Strong quantitative mindset and analytical skills;
  • Passion and expertise in data exploration, data analysis, and model development;
  • Strong knowledge of Statistics, Data Mining, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning;
  • Solid programming experience in Python;
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git);
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases and SQL programming;
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Redis);
  • Experience with vector databases (e.g., ChromaDB, Qdrant, Pinecone);
  • Experience using AI Cloud APIs from at least one major provider (Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, AWS);
  • Experience processing unstructured data;
  • Strong knowledge of NLP and Computer Vision techniques (Text Categorization, Entity Extraction, Generation, Object Detection, Segmentation);
  • Experience with Neural Networks, CNNs, and Transformers;
  • Knowledge of Generative AI techniques and Large Language Models (LLMs);
  • Experience in neural network training and fine-tuning techniques (e.g., Super-Convergence, PEFT, LoRA);
  • Experience with major deep learning libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and model repositories (Hugging Face);
  • Knowledge of prompting techniques (one-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought);
  • Fluent professional proficiency in Spanish and English (mandatory).


Nice to Have
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Experience developing and applying Generative AI models in industrial environments;
  • Software development experience and strong knowledge of SDLC;
  • Experience with data/model versioning frameworks (MLflow, DVC);
  • Experience with generative networks for controlled content production (text, images, video);
  • Experience building Search Engines, Entity Extraction systems, or Image Anomaly Detection solutions;
  • Knowledge of Explainable AI models (SHAP, LIME, Anchors);
  • Experience working in Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Knowledge of Data Engineering concepts (ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, distributed processing);
  • Experience with big data frameworks such as Apache Spark;
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks (workspace management, notebooks, Delta Lake, MLflow integration);
  • Experience designing scalable data architectures in cloud environments.


Soft Skills
  • Strong consulting mindset;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills;
  • Client-oriented and results-driven;
  • Teamwork attitude;
  • Attention to detail and ability to work under deadlines.


Why BIP?

Growth & Learning

Access to 300+ courses on emerging technologies and business topics, personalized development programs, and continuous training initiatives to support your professional and personal growth.

Flexibility & Work-Life Integration

Hybrid working model with flexibility to balance remote and office work in agreement with your manager and project needs, plus initiatives supporting work-life balance.

Health & Benefits

Private health insurance, wellness platforms, meal vouchers, and an attractive benefits package.

Family & Parenthood

Support for new parents, including enhanced parental leave benefits and dedicated initiatives during and after parental leave.

Inclusion & Values

We promote uniqueness and equal opportunities for everyone. We are committed to creating an ethical, inclusive, and welcoming work environment.

Next Steps

Once we receive your CV, we will carefully review your profile. If there is a match with this or other open positions within the Group, we will contact you to start our mutual introduction process.

The selection process generally includes an HR interview, a technical interview with a Line Manager, and potentially a final interview with a Partner. The number and order of interviews may vary.

About Us

Founded in 2003, BIP combines the historical excellence of management consulting with innovation and digitalization. Today we are more than 5,000 professionals across 13 countries, delivering over 4,500 projects worldwide.

We support our clients in driving large-scale impact through Digital Transformation, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Industry 4.0, IoT, and disruptive technologies across all industries.

We believe in excellence as our guiding principle and adopt an ethical and fair approach toward everyone who chooses to work with us, fostering an environment where people grow together through diverse expertise.

Title: Data Scientist, Parameta Solutions (Madrid)
Description:
The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

Founded in London in 1866, the Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,300 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

About Parameta Solutions

Parameta Solutions is the Data & Analytics division of TP ICAP Group. The business provides clients with unbiased OTC content and proprietary data, in-depth insights across price discovery, risk management, benchmark and indices, and pre and post-trade analytics. Its post-trade solutions offering helps market participants control their counterparty and regulatory risks through a growing range of tools that manage balance-sheet exposure, as well as compression and optimisation services. The Data & Analytics division includes the following brands: Tullett Prebon Information, PVM Data Services, ICAP Information and Burton-Taylor Consulting.

Role Overview

We are on a mission to harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to shape the next generation of financial intelligence solutions. As we continue to expand our Data Science capability, we are seeking a talented and innovative Data Scientist to develop cutting-edge analytical and Generative AI solutions that drive commercial value across our business.

Based in Madrid and working within Parameta Solutions, you will play a key role in designing, developing and deploying scalable data products that transform complex financial data into actionable insights. Working closely with Data Engineering, Product, Commercial and Technology teams, you will leverage advanced analytics, cloud technologies and Generative AI capabilities to support the evolution of our data-driven product suite.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a rapidly growing function at the forefront of financial data innovation, helping to shape the future of analytics, intelligence and AI-powered solutions across the organisation.

Role Responsibilities


Design, develop and maintain robust Python-based applications for financial data analysis, transformation, enrichment and automation.
Build scalable data science solutions that extract actionable insights from large and complex financial datasets.
Develop interactive dashboards, monitoring frameworks and visualisation tools to support strategic and operational decision-making.
Enhance, support and continuously improve existing data applications, data quality frameworks and analytical platforms.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Product Managers and commercial stakeholders to ensure the scalability, reliability and usability of data products and models.
Apply software engineering best practices, including modular development, code reviews, automated testing, version control and CI/CD methodologies.
Design, develop and maintain Generative AI solutions that enhance internal processes, analytical capabilities and customer-facing products.
Leverage AWS cloud technologies and services to build scalable AI and machine learning applications, making full use of innovative capabilities available through our strategic AWS partnership.
Evaluate emerging AI, machine learning and data science technologies, identifying opportunities to improve products, processes and client outcomes.
Contribute to the ongoing evolution of Parameta Solutions' data science and AI capabilities, helping establish best practices and technical standards across the team.


Experience / Competences

Essential


Master’s or PhD in Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or another quantitative discipline.
Proven experience developing production-grade Python applications within a data science, machine learning or quantitative analytics environment.
Demonstrated software engineering fundamentals including object-oriented programming, modular design patterns and version control.
Experience building and deploying analytical, machine learning or AI-driven solutions in a commercial environment.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying and manipulating large-scale datasets.
Experience working with modern data and engineering platforms such as Snowflake, Airflow, Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience developing or integrating Generative AI, Large Language Model (LLM) or machine learning solutions.
Demonstrated understanding of cloud-based architectures and services, particularly within AWS environments.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.


Desired


Industry experience in a computational or quantitative data science role.
Experience developing customer-facing analytics, recommendation engines or AI-powered products.
Knowledge of MLOps practices and model deployment, monitoring and governance frameworks.
Experience working within agile product and engineering environments.
Passion for emerging technologies and a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.


Job Band & Level


Professional / 5


#PARAMETA

Not The Perfect Fit?

Concerned that you may not meet the criteria precisely? At TP ICAP, we wholeheartedly believe in fostering inclusivity and cultivating a work environment where everyone can flourish, regardless of your personal or professional background. If you are enthusiastic about this role but find that your experience doesn't align perfectly with every aspect of the job description, we strongly encourage you to apply. You may be the ideal candidate for this position or another opportunity within our organisation. Our dedicated Talent Acquisition team is here to assist you in recognising how your unique skills and abilities can be a valuable contribution. Don't hesitate to take the leap and explore the possibilities. Your potential is what truly matters to us.

Company Statement

We know that the best innovation happens when diverse people with different perspectives and skills work together in an inclusive atmosphere. That's why we're building a culture where everyone plays a part in making people feel welcome, ready and willing to contribute. TP ICAP Accord - our Employee Network - is a central to this. As well as representing specific groups, TP ICAP Accord helps increase awareness, collaboration, shares best practice, and holds our firm to account for driving continuous cultural improvement.

Location

Spain - Paseo de la Castellana - Madrid

Mission

Are you ready to take part in the upcoming AI revolution of the business world? If the answer is a resounding "yes," we have an extraordinary opportunity for you!

About Us

Aily Labs is a B2B SaaS company building an AI-powered decision intelligence app for enterprises. Our mobile-first platform combines company data with advanced machine learning, large language models and agentic AI to give business leaders clear, actionable insights in real time.

Instead of traditional dashboards and reports, Aily delivers simple, personalized recommendations powered by GenAI that help teams decide and act faster across finance, supply chain, R&D, commercial, and more. The app is designed to be intuitive for end users and easy to integrate for IT, so companies can move from analysis and indecision to confident, data-driven decisions every day.

Founded in 2020 in Munich, Aily Labs has grown into a global team of 300+ people across Munich, Barcelona, Madrid, Cluj, and New York. Our mission is to democratize AI in business and enable leaders to Lead Boldly, turning complex data into decisions that drive real, measurable impact.

We are looking for Senior or Lead Data Scientists and AI Engineers who are passionate about the power of AI and who thrive at the intersection of business, analytics, and AI: someone who not only trains models but also deeply understands the business context in which they’re applied. Your job is to make sure AI is solving the right problems, using the right approaches, and driving measurable impact.

About This Team - Agent Pillar

We develop the Super Agent – an agentic decision advisor that guides users from questions to decisions through natural dialogue. We also create vertical decision intelligence agents that synthesize insights across domains, helping F500 clients turn complex data into measurable business outcomes. This is all pulled together with the GenAI systems that surface insights and decision triggers to ensure users can respond to risks and opportunities immediately.

We're building production LLM systems at enterprise scale – which means tackling hard problems in evaluation, reliability, and latency while staying at the research frontier. Our challenges include grounding agents in structured business data, coordinating multi-agent workflows, and ensuring robust performance in high-stakes decision contexts. We pair strong engineering with applied research, contributing to the field through publications and establishing technical differentiation in a fast-moving space.

Build and maintain features with strong ownership over quality and performance.

Own key features and projects, designing and improving models, pipelines and experimentation frameworks.

Communicate and align with stakeholders, identifying gaps and opportunities and turning business requirements into AI solutions.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk
Description:
Creditstar Group is a rapidly growing international consumer finance company, headquartered in Tallinn, Estonia and operating in multiple European markets.

At the core, we are a financial technology company that uses automated processes, algorithms and data analysis to make financial instruments easily available to a population of more than 175 million people in our target markets. We are a team of ambitious professionals who value innovation, speed, high growth and high performance. For more information on the group, please visit www.creditstar.com.

Our vision is to build and deliver digital banking products of the future. If you want to be part of this, here is your chance.

YOUR POSITION: SENIOR DATA SCIENTIST

YOUR ROLE:

How about being a key player in driving the data strategy in the company? We are looking for a Data Scientist who will own and develop the data science framework for all our Products across the Group.

As a Data Scientist you will be at the forefront of underwriting development, defining how and what data should be collected to improve our decision making and enable discovery of actionable insights that will improve the experience of our customers in 8 countries. You will be helping Product and Risk Managers make data-informed decisions and lead your own projects. With us, you can push your creative ideas forward and take care of making innovation in the data-driven world!

Requirements

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:


Build models based on data to predict customers' payment behavior
Design A/B experiments, analyze the results, and provide decision recommendations
Work in tight cooperation with stakeholders to analyze complex data and provide data-driven insights for business-critical decisions
Review the work and provide feedback to data analysts and data scientists
Share your knowledge and provide training on best practices in data processing and analytics methodologies
Define data science strategy, communicate and align it with the management and other teams
Propose, assess, prioritize, and lead data science projects
Work closely with data engineers to ensure the best possible data infrastructure across products
Research and implement best practices and standards in Data Science across product teams


Requirements:


At least 5 years professional experience related to data science
BS in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Physics or Statistics
Excellent knowledge of SQL and Python (or a similar scripting language)
Knowledge of machine learning and statistical modeling techniques
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Good project management skills
Proactive attitude, sense of ownership, ability to work autonomously but also to coach other team members
Having a startup mindset and willingness to work in a fast evolving environment
Fluency in spoken and written English
Passion about what you do


BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:


Experience of project and people leadership
Previous work experience in the Financial/Fintech sector


Benefits

Benefits:


Dynamic, challenging, and rewarding work within a rapidly growing international company;
Chance to contribute to the business' decision-making processes and make a tangible impact;
Talented and fun international team who always has your back;
Supportive environment facilitating growth and achievement;
Flexible working hours;
Regular company parties and events;
Office with games, pool table, free snacks/drinks and the possibility to work remotely;
Powerful equipment and modern tools;
On-demand sponsorship for your professional development;
Competitive remuneration package


Gross salary range for this position is €4000-€5000 per month.

Title: Senior Data Scientist (Growth)
Description:
About Dwelly

Dwelly is building the AI operating system for residential lettings. Its growing network of agencies provides its AI with real-world data, continuous feedback, and control over complete workflows, making exceptional service the standard for landlords and tenants. Today, Dwelly operates more than 15,000 properties and $470 million in GMV, making it one of the UK’s ten largest lettings operators. The company has raised $263 million.

We’re a fast-growing, product-focused company, backed by top-tier investors and led by a team with deep experience in real estate, technology, and operations.

Position Summary

We are launching Growth as a dedicated direction — everything that moves units on the platform and revenue per unit. You will be the first data person in it, owning the analytical agenda together with the commercial and product leads rather than servicing a queue of chart requests. A thought-partner role: bring hypotheses, argue about priorities, say when a plan won't work, then build the thing that settles it.

A note on the title. We have always asked our analysts for statistics, real programming, data pipelines and modest ML — we just never wrote it down. We are now naming the job the way the market names it. If "Data Scientist" means a research seat with a clean feature store handed to you, this isn't that. If it means going from raw messy data to a decision without waiting for anyone, it is exactly that.

A normal estate agency knows almost nothing about its own business: a CRM with names, a bank feed, and the memory of whoever has worked there longest. We are in a different position. Across a portfolio of agencies we hold years of conversations with landlords and tenants, every property management job with the full record of what went wrong, every payment and arrear, and thousands of hours of calls. Most of it is unstructured, which until recently meant unusable. With LLMs it is a feature store — and that changes the class of question we can answer. No agency on the island can do this, and few proptech companies can.

Why it's cool: a data asset nobody else in this market can replicate — years of conversations, jobs, payments and calls, and permission to point LLMs at all of it; experienced founders who have already walked this path before (built PIK Arenda), and now significant traction shown in the UK already; a large but compact and well-capitalized market of 20 thousand agencies on the island; Growth starts now, so you define the agenda and the metrics instead of inheriting legacy dashboards; and we are now on the way from 0 to 1, then there will be scaling 1 → N, so there's an opportunity to see how companies of different stages grow and develop.

Key Responsibilities


Churn Early-Warning
Churn early-warning that names the cause, not just the risk. Combine arrears, job SLA breaches and tenancy events with intent and sentiment extracted from conversations and call recordings. Separate the landlord who is selling the flat from the one we lost through a botched boiler repair — different playbooks, one goes to retention, the other straight into the sales funnel — and put a pound figure on each cause so operations can prioritise honestly.
Share-of-Wallet Expansion
Turn share of wallet from a survey anecdote into a ranked call list. Landlords hold roughly 60 properties off-platform for every 100 they place with us. Estimate each landlord's hidden portfolio, rank by expected units won, then mine the resulting call recordings for why they said no — that is usually where the next product comes from.
Pricing & Elasticity
Find the price sensitivity of the landlord base. Our acquired agencies charge wildly different fees. Reconstruct what is actually charged, estimate elasticity by segment, recommend the maximum defensible uplift — then hold yourself to your own churn forecast and correct the model. The same machinery prioritises the rent review backlog by expected pounds.
Rent Guarantee Underwriting
Underwrite Rent Guarantee off our own loss book. Probability of default and severity from our arrears and collections history, real pricing, eligibility rules, and monitoring that flags a deteriorating book early. We own the loss data, which is why we can build this and a broker can't.
Growth Experimentation
Make growth experiments actually readable. Tenant-side products, opt-in payment flows, upsell paths and outreach sequences — designed with holdouts, power and an uplift estimate, not a before-and-after chart.
Growth Data Layer
Own the Growth data layer. Pipelines from the platform database, payments, comms, call transcripts and PM jobs; the metrics tree everyone argues from; and an eval harness for the LLM extraction, because a classifier nobody has measured is a rumour.


Qualifications And Preferred Background


Strong communication skills and fluency in English.
Higher degree education.
Startup mentality: resilience, adaptability, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
Customer-centric mindset: focus on delivering value to end-users or clients.
Strong problem-solving skills – ability to approach challenges logically and propose practical solutions.
5+ years of experience in the role of DA / DS.
Possess the high level of autonomy and "full-stack analyst" skill set expected of a Senior DA grade.
Write Python and SQL and build your own pipelines (dbt or equivalent). Data engineering is part of the job, not an adjacent one.
Have real statistical depth: experiment design, causal inference without randomisation (diff-in-diff, matching, synthetic control), survival analysis, elasticity. You volunteer the caveat before someone else finds it.
Apply pragmatic ML — churn propensity, uplift, pricing, simple forecasting. For the current state we prefer a well-calibrated logistic regression in production to a gradient boosting model in a notebook.
Are fluent with LLMs on messy text and audio, and know how to build eval sets to prove the output is trustworthy.
Are comfortable reading backend code and fetching the data yourself when nobody has prepared it.
Work as a thought partner to business and product — you form your own view and push back. Not a ticket-taker.
Nice to have: have priced or underwritten a financial product — insurance, guarantee, credit — off your own loss data; enjoy being the first analyst in a direction and defining the metrics tree from scratch; and like talking to Managing Directors and agents and learning the domain first-hand, rather than only through the database.


Compensation & Benefits:


Competitive salary with the potential for equity options based on performance, recognising exceptional contributions to our integration success.


What is it like being a Dwell-er?

Feel free to check out Dwelly Core Principles. That’s about what we believe in, how we operate and make decisions.

What we offer is not a fancy office or a static workplace. Instead, this is solving one of worlds’ most complex problems in the largest consumer industry in the world (residential rentals), to improve the experience for >30% of households (>5M in the UK, and >100M including EU and US) that live in rental homes.

This is about disrupting the largest, most antiquated industry in the world, with one of the strongest operational and technical teams that exist in the UK and the EU. We work hard, and we shoot for extremely ambitious results. But we want people to be proud of what they’ve built and be able to look back and say one day “hell yeah, that was me that did it all”.


Customer obsession rather than competitive focus
Passion for invention
Operational excellence
Long-term thinking


By applying for this position, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data for recruitment purposes for up to 365 days, in accordance with our data retention policy and applicable data protection laws.

Title: Principal Data Scientist, Real World Evidence
Description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function

Data Analytics & Computational Sciences

Job Sub Function

Data Science

Job Category

Scientific/Technology

All Job Posting Locations:

Barcelona, Spain, Madrid, Spain

Job Description

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine R&D Data Science and Digital Health are recruiting for a Principal Data Scientist, Real World Evidence (RWE).

Madrid and Barcelona are the considered locations. Hybrid work model.

J&J Innovative Medicine develops treatments that improve the health of people worldwide. Research and development areas encompass oncology, immunology, neuroscience, cardiopulmonary and specialty ophthalmology. Our goal is to help people live longer, healthier lives. We have produced and marketed many first-in-class prescription medications and are poised to serve the broad needs of the healthcare market – from patients to practitioners and from clinics to hospitals. To learn more about Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine visit https://innovativemedicine.jnj.com/

The R&D Data, Data Science & AI, Real-World Evidence (RWE) team at J&J Innovative Medicine is dedicated to developing innovative evidence solutions and critical insights through diverse data sources including RWD, trial data and emerging innovative data sources, to support our clinical programs and regulatory submissions. The Principal Data Scientist will collaborate closely with strategic partners in R&D Data, Data Science & AI, as well as multidisciplinary teams within J&J Innovative Medicine, to develop and implement evidence and insights to improve patient outcomes and enhance clinical development in Neuroscience.

Key Responsibilities


Contribute to the development of a portfolio of RWE projects based on RWD that will provide key insights to our pipeline assets
Leverage emerging scientific and technological developments to generate new research ideas, solutions and initiatives using real-world data
End-to-end experience in RWE studies including conceptualizing the research questions, data feasibility, study design, analysis, programming, and interpretation
Analyze and interpret data to support urgent requests from internal and external stakeholders
Ensure quality of design, execution, and publication of real-world evidence studies, and quality of models & tools

TL;DR Kharon is seeking a full-time Data Scientist, Retrieval & Agentic Systems based in Madrid.

Responsibilities


Owning and evolving Corestream, Kharon's risk intelligence feed — a dynamic platform that surfaces entity-level insights and topic-based risk narratives to customers
Redesigning and improving Kharon's semantic search capabilities, opening new avenues for content discovery — drawing on modern approaches including BM25 tuning, semantic distance, RAG, and reranking
Integrating Kharon's risk analysis outputs into the search layer, ensuring that graph-based insights surface meaningfully within search results and sub-network exploration
Driving the evolution of Kharon's narrative generation pipeline — how we take graph and analytical data and transform it into compelling, accurate written intelligence for customers
Partnering with Product and Engineering to take ownership of the Corestream roadmap and push it to its next stage
Tweaking and optimizing the metrics that define search quality and narrative relevance


Qualifications


A proven interest or experience in global security, financial crimes, sanctions, export controls, or related domains
3+ years of experience in a Data Science or AI Engineering role
Hands-on experience with semantic search — including familiarity with BM25, vector search, reranking, and retrieval evaluation
Experience with RAG pipelines and working with agentic systems in production
Proficiency in Python and SQL
Strong product alignment — able to read a roadmap, take ownership of tickets, and drive initiatives forward independently
Bonus: Experience with graph-aware search or integrating knowledge graph outputs into retrieval systems


About Kharon

Kharon operates at the nexus of global security and is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible.

From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products. Given the significance of our work and the increasing global reliance on our insights, we are looking for a Data Scientist, Retrieval & Agentic Systems to join us as we work to shape the way businesses perceive and navigate global risks.

Disclosures

Kharon is committed to cultivating and maintaining a workplace that is free from harassment and discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation or identity, neurodiversity, appearances, age, protected veteran status, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

If you require any adjustment to participate in the recruitment process, please contact apply@kharon.com. You must have the right to work in Europe and Spain. Kharon is unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that Kharon will process your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the EU General Data Protection Regulation and Spanish data protection legislation. For information about how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice at www.kharon.com/privacy. You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data, to object to or restrict its processing, and to lodge a complaint with the Spanish data protection authority, the AEPD, at www.aepd.es. To exercise your rights, contact us at apply@kharon.com.

If your application is unsuccessful, your data will be retained for up to 12 months before being securely deleted. If you accept a role, your data will transfer to your employee record.

Title: Principal Data Scientist – Agents Team - BCN/MAD
Description:
Mission

Are you ready to take part in the upcoming AI revolution of the business world? If the answer is a resounding "yes," we have an extraordinary opportunity for you!

About Us

Aily Labs is a B2B SaaS company building an AI-powered decision intelligence app for enterprises. Our mobile-first platform combines company data with advanced machine learning, large language models and agentic AI to give business leaders clear, actionable insights in real time.

Instead of traditional dashboards and reports, Aily delivers simple, personalized recommendations powered by GenAI that help teams decide and act faster across finance, supply chain, R&D, commercial, and more. The app is designed to be intuitive for end users and easy to integrate for IT, so companies can move from analysis and indecision to confident, data-driven decisions every day.

Founded in 2020 in Munich, Aily Labs has grown into a global team of 300+ people across Munich, Barcelona, Madrid, Cluj, and New York. Our mission is to democratize AI in business and enable leaders to Lead Boldly, turning complex data into decisions that drive real, measurable impact.

We are looking for Principal Data Scientists and AI Engineers who are passionate about the power of AI and who thrive at the intersection of business, analytics, and AI: someone who not only trains models but also deeply understands the business context in which they’re applied. Your job is to make sure AI is solving the right problems, using the right approaches, and driving measurable impact.

About This Team - Agent Pillar

We develop the Super Agent – an agentic decision advisor that guides users from questions to decisions through natural dialogue. We also create vertical decision intelligence agents that synthesize insights across domains, helping F500 clients turn complex data into measurable business outcomes. This is all pulled together with the GenAI systems that surface insights and decision triggers to ensure users can respond to risks and opportunities immediately.

We're building production LLM systems at enterprise scale – which means tackling hard problems in evaluation, reliability, and latency while staying at the research frontier. Our challenges include grounding agents in structured business data, coordinating multi-agent workflows, and ensuring robust performance in high-stakes decision contexts. We pair strong engineering with applied research, contributing to the field through publications and establishing technical differentiation in a fast-moving space.

Your profile

Core responsibilities - 7+ years of experience


Lead, design, and maintain AI-driven solutions across multiple workstreams to solve complex business challenges.
Own delivery across several projects: shape the roadmap with PM/Eng, scope initiatives, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure timely, high-quality releases.
Communicate and align with senior internal and external stakeholders, identifying domain-wide opportunities and influencing strategy.
Provide leadership for the Data Science team: mentor and manage, define modelling and evaluation standards, and drive impactful cross-functional delivery.


Who we’re looking for


Someone who thrives at the intersection of business, analytics and AI and wants to ensure AI solves the right problems with measurable impact.
A scientist and builder: you explore multiple approaches, analyze results and iterate fast, balancing cutting-edge techniques with simple, scalable solutions.
A strong communicator who adapts the message to different audiences and enjoys working cross-functionally with product, engineering and business stakeholders.
Someone with a startup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, proactive and hands-on when something needs fixing or improving.
Ready to Lead Boldly – helping business leaders make decisive decisions powered by real-time AI insights.
Applicants must already have the legal right to work in Spain


Location & details


Locations: Madrid (MAD), Barcelona (BCN)
Contract type: Permanent.
Work policy: hybrid (2 days per week in the office)

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
¿Quiénes somos?

Somos una compañía tecnológica especializada en Inteligencia Artificial, IA Generativa, Analytics, Gobierno del Dato, Cloud y arquitecturas Event Driven, pero sobre todo somos un equipo con conocimiento, criterio y muchas ganas de hacer las cosas bien.

Trabajamos con talento altamente especializado, esté donde esté, y apostamos por una forma de crecer basada en la confianza, la autonomía y la participación. Nos mueve la excelencia tecnológica, la orientación a negocio y el sentido común, pero también el entusiasmo, la creatividad y la convicción de que la tecnología necesita alma, propósito y personas capaces de convertir la complejidad en soluciones reales.




¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos a un/a Data Scientist enfocado en forecasting de series temporales para el área de Finanzas con 2 años de experiencia en responsabilidades similares. Perfil con base técnica sólida - escribir buen código y manejarse con soltura en el desarrollo, aunque la productivización final se aborde en colaboración con Data Engineers.

Grado en Data Science, Informática, Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Finanzas cuantitativas o afín (MS/PhD valorable).
Python sólido, con buenas prácticas de desarrollo (código limpio, testeado, versionado).
PySpark para procesamiento distribuido de datos a gran escala.
Experiencia demostrable en forecasting de series temporales (clásico y/o ML).
Aplicación de técnicas de ML sobre datasets grandes (clustering, clasificación, regresión, detección de anomalías).
SQL para acceso y transformación de datos.
Comprensión sólida de metodologías ágiles.
Inglés profesional.




Será un PLUS:

Dominio financiero (planificación, riesgo, FP&A, tesorería).
Tecnologías de bases de datos en cloud (p. ej. AWS) y despliegue en infraestructura cloud de datos/analítica.
Contenedores y pipelines/microservicios (Docker, Kubernetes).
Herramientas de dashboarding (Dash, Tableau).




¿Cómo será tu día a día?

Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener modelos de forecasting de series temporales (métodos estadísticos clásicos —ARIMA/SARIMA, suavizado exponencial, modelos de espacio de estados— y enfoques ML/probabilísticos) aplicados a problemáticas financieras.
Escribir código limpio, ordenado y bien documentado en Python, aplicando buenas prácticas (modularidad, pruebas, control de versiones) para que los modelos sean reproducibles y mantenibles.
Procesar y modelar datos a gran escala con PySpark, construyendo pipelines eficientes sobre datasets financieros voluminosos.
Crear modelos repetibles, interpretables, dinámicos y escalables, y colaborar con data engineers y leads de negocio en su integración en aplicaciones y herramientas.
Ingeniería de features combinando fuentes internas y externas para mejorar la precisión predictiva.
Apoyar la monitorización, mantenimiento y mejora de los modelos una vez en uso.
Comunicar el enfoque analítico (relevancia, trade-offs) a partners de negocio y traducir resultados a implicaciones financieras accionables.
Trabajar de forma iterativa e incremental en un equipo ágil cross-funcional, buscando mejorar velocidad y calidad sprint a sprint.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Pertenecer a una empresa a la vanguardia tecnológica y centrada en las Personas, ponemos al trabajador en el centro de todo lo que hacemos. Creemos en una cultura horizontal, sin egos, en un entorno donde se valoran tanto las ideas como las personas.

Contrato indefinido y salario entre los 28.000 y 34.000 euros brutos/año de entrada, ajustado según tu experiencia (nuestro plan de carrera incluye 2 revisiones anuales). También tendrás a tu disposición un plan de formación especializado, participación en la propiedad y los beneficios de Mática: Wetaca gratuito en la oficina dos días a la semana, horario flexible con facilidades para trabajar desde donde quieras, seguro de salud, retribución flexible con Cobee, además de las vacaciones habituales, ofrecemos una semana extra en Navidad y tres días adicionales en Semana Santa.

También recibirás un divertido Welcome Kit con portátil (podrás escoger entre varios modelos Mac o Windows), móvil, botella personalizada, auriculares bluetooth y golosinas.

Cuando estés en nuestra oficina, en el centro de Barcelona o Madrid, la fruta, los cafés y los refrescos corren a cuenta de Mática. ¡Ah! Y si eres amante de los animales, te gustará saber esto: ¡nuestras oficinas son Pet-friendly!




Si te interesa, escríbenos por LinkedIn o envía tu CV a seleccion@maticapartners.com
